blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Create Page
blocks.body:
**Create** → **Page**. Parent folder. **Template**. **Title**. **Name**. Then **Open** or **Done** (verify the button).

A **template** here is the page shape the website team already built. It is not File > New in Oxygen.

**Name** is the URL bit. **Title** is what people read. Lowercase hyphen names look like topic files. They are not. There is no concept template here.

Page **Properties** hold title, tags, times :  fill what an author is asked to fill. Do not hunt developer tabs.

If you have no instance, the wizard in the video plus a labeled mock is the lab.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You treat the page name as a booklet pointer, or you skip template choice, or you paste a developer setup as the lab.

Expected: Log with parent, template, title, name. Three properties. Mock labeled.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: From video, instance, or labeled mock: Create Page. Note parent folder, template, title, and name (the URL bit).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week9/field-log-58.txt with a fillable page: title Kitepump HP-40, name kitepump-hp-40, template (write the template name you saw, or ‘standard page template :  verify’).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Page properties: title, description, on/off time if shown. Do not invent fields you did not see.

blocks.q: Page name vs page title. Which one is the URL bit?
options: Name :  title is the human heading
The short line under a DITA title
blocks.why: Title can change for display. Name is the path. Verify labels in your AEM version.

blocks.q: You pick a template at create time. Can you casually swap it later like a DITA page type?
options: Often no :  the template is the page shape they already built. Changing it is a lead or developer move
blocks.why: Authors choose from allowed templates. They do not redesign the template this week.

blocks.q: A template here is the same as File > New in Oxygen. True or not?
options: Not true. In Oxygen a template starts a help page. In AEM a template is the web-page shape already built for that site
True if the name is lowercase
blocks.why: Same English word. Two desks. Define it each time.
